# E2E real-producer fixtures

`source.xlsx` and `source.ods` are **not** hand-crafted — they were generated by a real
office suite from `source.csv`, so `src/lib.rs`'s `diff_reader_tests::diff_real_producer_xlsx`
/ `diff_real_producer_ods` read genuine producer output (real ZIP/XML structure, real
shared-string/entity encoding, real ODS sparse-representation quirks) rather than a
hand-built approximation of one, and cross-check the result against `calamine` (the same
independent-oracle pattern the rest of that test module uses for elixcee's own writer
output).

Generated with LibreOffice 26.2.5.2 (`soffice --headless`):

```sh
soffice --headless --convert-to xlsx:"Calc MS Excel 2007 XML" source.csv
soffice --headless --convert-to ods source.csv
```

To regenerate (e.g. after a LibreOffice upgrade, to see whether producer output
changed): re-run the two commands above from this directory and diff the result before
committing — a changed fixture invalidates whatever assertions in
`diff_real_producer_xlsx`/`diff_real_producer_ods` depended on the old
shared-string/repeat-count/row-position shape.

Notable real-producer quirks `source.csv`'s content was chosen to elicit (found by
inspecting the generated XML directly, not assumed) — each was confirmed to actually
reproduce a bug in `src/reader.rs` before the fix (`git log --oneline -- src/reader.rs`),
not just to exercise syntax that happens to parse fine either way:

- The blank row (`,,,`) becomes `<table:table-cell table:number-columns-repeated="4"/>`
  in `source.ods`; a later row with 3 leading blank columns then real content
  (`,,,after-column-gap`) becomes `<table:table-cell
  table:number-columns-repeated="3"/><table:table-cell>...</table:table-cell>` — the real
  content must land at column 4, not column 2, or the reader is silently
  reading a previous producer's file that hasn't hit this repeat encoding yet.
- Three more consecutive blank rows collapse into one `<table:table-row
  table:number-rows-repeated="3">` — the next real row (`Carol`) must land at row 9, not
  row 6.
- The same blank run is dropped entirely from `source.xlsx`'s `<sheetData>` (no `<row
  r="4">`/`r="6"`/`r="7"`/`r="8"` elements at all — XLSX has no repeat-count mechanism,
  it just omits empty rows) — row numbers in the remaining `<row r="...">` elements are
  non-contiguous, and `Carol` also lands at row 9 there, for an unrelated reason (omission
  rather than repeat-count), which is why both fixtures were kept in sync at the same row.
- The CJK+Latin mixed string (`unicode: café ★ 日本語`) is split across two `<r><t>`
  rich-text runs in `source.xlsx`'s `sharedStrings.xml` (LibreOffice switches font per
  script), exercising multi-run `<si>` concatenation.
- The `Note` column's quote/ampersand/angle-bracket content exercises named-entity
  decoding (`&quot;`/`&amp;`/`&lt;`/`&gt;`) on real producer output, as a non-regression
  check for the same `xml_unescape` rewrite.
